candidates.change_summary: Move the external call to msg.sender.call to occur before zeroing the caller's credit and updating balance (introduces a reentrancy vulnerability changing post-withdraw state).
Do not set the caller's credit to zero after sending funds (leaves credit unchanged, causing differing observable state after withdraw).
Subtract zero from balance instead of the owed credit (skips decreasing balance, leaving balance unchanged after withdraw).
Require the call result before updating balance and zeroing credit (reverts before state changes when external call fails, altering observable post-call state).
Set the caller's credit to oCredit instead of zero after withdrawal (leaves credit unchanged, causing different observable state).
